one_line: AI firms raise billions, compute capacity expands, and safety concerns intensify across the industry.

themes.title: AI firms secure multibillion funding
themes.text: DeepSeek raised about $15 billion and OpenAI is negotiating up to $30 billion, both seeking high valuations.

stories.headline: DeepSeek raises about $15 billion in funding round days after US restrictions
OpenAI seeks up to $30 billion funding at $1.25 trillion valuation ahead of IPO

themes.title: Global AI compute capacity scales up
themes.text: SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute by end‑2027, while Firebird secured a license for 45,000 NVIDIA Grace GPUs to build a Kazakh data center targeting up to 500 MW.

stories.headline: SpaceX aims for 13 GW AI compute capacity by end of 2027
Kazakhstan expands AI compute with 45,000 Grace GPUs and new data centers

themes.title: AI safety and security concerns rise
themes.text: Chinese‑aligned hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants; major US banks are blocking third‑party AI agents from customer accounts; researchers released EpiSEM‑Bench and reported inconsistent instrumental behavior in RLVR training, highlighting ongoing safety challenges.

stories.headline: Chinese hackers used AI agents to breach ConnectWise and access 2,250 Microsoft 365 tenants
Major US banks block third‑party AI agents from customer accounts
EpiSEM-Bench evaluates safety of LLM agents when key facts are omitted
Study finds RLVR training does not consistently increase instrumental behavior in OLMo-3
